title: Prompt Maker
app_desc: Prompt generator with hierarchical categories, param defaults, and smart replacement
output_placeholder:
Generated prompt text appears here
You can adjust or modify the output
drop_zone_aria: Dictionary file upload area, drag & drop supported
drop_hint: Drag & drop a .txt/.md dictionary file here, or click to browse
preview_placeholder: Select a prompt title in the tree; its raw content appears here (including {{param}} targets)
params_empty_selected: No parameters yet; selecting a prompt with params will auto-generate a form (with defaults)
params_none_ready: This prompt has no parameters — you can add it directly
usage_hint: Upload → select a title → adjust params (defaults prefilled) → Add
info_format_desc: Define items with $$Category.Title$$, an optional @@param:default@@ line, non-empty lines below as content, supporting {{param}} placeholders.
info_usage_desc: Upload or drag & drop a dictionary file → expand the tree and select a prompt → adjust params (defaults prefilled) → add to the output; you can copy, undo, and clear.
confirm_clear_desc: Are you sure you want to clear the loaded dictionary? This action cannot be undone.
modal_format_intro: A dictionary file (.txt / .md) follows these format rules:
modal_step1_desc: Wrapped in $$...$$, use "." to separate categories and the title. The last part is the prompt title; the rest are categories (nested supported).
modal_step2_desc: Placed right below the path line, wrapped in @@...@@ with params separated by ",". Use name:default to set a default value; otherwise just write the name.
modal_step3_desc: All non-empty lines after the path (and optional param) line belong to the prompt, until the next $$...$$ or the end of file. Use {{param}} placeholders in the content.
modal_step4_desc: Here is a complete example with defaults:
modal_tip: Parameter defaults are prefilled into the inputs; you can edit them before adding. Omitting the colon leaves it empty.
no_valid_entries: No valid prompt entries found. Please check the file format.
clipboard_unsupported: Clipboard API not supported in this environment
no_selection: Please select a prompt in the dictionary tree first
load_failed: Failed to load language resources. Please refresh.
